text_en: “At that time Michael, the great prince, the protector of your people, shall arise. There shall be a time of anguish, such as has never occurred since nations first came into existence. But at that time your people shall be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
text_cn: 那时保佑你国家子民的伟大护守天使弥额尔必要起来；那将是一个灾难的时期，是自开国以来，直到那时从未有过的；那时，你的人民，凡是名录在那书上的，都必得救。

text_en: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
text_cn: 许多长眠于尘土中的人，要醒起来：有的要入于永生，有的要永远蒙羞受辱。

text_en: Those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
text_cn: 贤明之士要发光有如穹苍的光辉；那些引导多人归于正义的人，要永远发光如同星辰。

text_en: But you, Daniel, keep the words secret and the book sealed until the time of the end. Many shall be running back and forth, and evil shall increase. ”
text_cn: 至于你，达尼尔！你要隐藏这些话，密封这部书，直到末期；将有许多人要探讨，因而智识必要增长。

text_en: Then I, Daniel, looked, and two others appeared, one standing on this bank of the stream and one on the other.
text_cn: 那时我达尼尔观望：看见另有两位天使，一位站在河岸这边，一位站在河岸那边。

text_en: One of them said to the man clothed in linen, who was upstream, “How long shall it be until the end of these wonders? ”
text_cn: 我就问那身穿细麻衣，站在河水上的人说：“几时这些奇事才会实现呢？”

text_en: The man clothed in linen, who was upstream, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven. And I heard him swear by the one who lives forever that it would be for a time, two times, and half a time, and that when the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end, all these things would be accomplished.
text_cn: 我听见那身穿细麻衣，站在河水上的人向天举起左手及右手，指着永生者起誓说：“的确，这事必须经过一段时期，另两段时期和半段时期：直到摧残圣民的势力终止时，这一切事才要实现。”

text_en: I heard but could not understand; so I said, “My lord, what shall be the outcome of these things? ”
text_cn: 我听了以后，仍不明白，便问说：“我主！这些事的结局究竟怎样？”

text_en: He said, “Go your way, Daniel, for the words are to remain secret and sealed until the time of the end.
text_cn: 他回答说：“达尼尔，你去吧！因为这些事隐藏密封，直到末期。

text_en: Many shall be purified, cleansed, and refined, but the wicked shall continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked shall understand, but those who are wise shall understand.
text_cn: 将有许多人要使自己纯洁清白，并受锻炼，而恶人却要更加作恶；凡作恶的人不能明白，惟有贤明之士才能明白。

text_en: From the time that the regular burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that desolates is set up, there shall be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
text_cn: 自从废弃日常祭，设立那招致荒凉的可憎之物的时候起，必要经历一千二百九十天。

text_en: Happy are those who persevere and attain the thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
text_cn: 凡能守候直到一千三百三十五天的，是有福的。

text_en: But you, go your way, and rest; you shall rise for your reward at the end of the days. ”
text_cn: 你应去等候末期，好好安息吧！到末日，你要起来接受你的福分。”
